web-guide-idea-79.audience: People who want to make a rangoli alongside others.
web-guide-idea-79.offer: Lead a manageable design with time for participants to practise. The shared making and feedback distinguish it from watching a time-lapse.
web-guide-idea-79.steps.0: Send a simple material list and design outline.
web-guide-idea-79.steps.1: Build the pattern in stages with close-up views.
web-guide-idea-79.steps.2: Invite everyone to show their result and offer one useful pointer.
web-guide-idea-79.equipment: A phone on an angled stand and suitable rangoli materials or a practice alternative.
web-guide-idea-79.returnReason: Create new seasonal patterns or increase complexity across sessions.
web-guide-idea-79.promotion: Show the exact beginner design or a representative sample, with approximate space needed.
web-guide-idea-79.metadataTitle: Rangoli Together — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-79.metadataDescription: Lead a design step by step and give everyone time to share their finished rangoli. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
